dishes.name: Rillettes du Mans
dishes.desc: Pork shoulder slow-cooked in fat and shredded, a protected local product. Spread on bread, it has been Le Mans' signature charcuterie since the 19th century.

dishes.name: Sablés de Sablé
dishes.desc: Crumbly butter shortbread from Sablé-sur-Sarthe, plain or with sugar. Sold in tins and bakeries across the Sarthe.

dishes.name: Entrammes cheese
dishes.desc: Soft washed-rind cheese from the Mayenne, made by monks near Entrammes and descended from Port-Salut. Mild and creamy, with an orange rind.

dishes.name: Boudin noir de Mortagne
dishes.desc: Black pudding from Mortagne-au-Perche in the Orne, soft and spiced, fried and eaten with apples. The town hosts a yearly boudin fair.

dishes.name: Loué chicken
dishes.desc: Free-range label chicken from Loué in the Sarthe, raised on grain and eaten roast or in cream sauce. Served in Sarthe restaurants and bought at markets.
